description: This file is a markdown tutorial/documentation explaining how to handle file uploads with FastAPI, including definitions of `File` and `UploadFile`, handling form data, optional files, multiple file uploads, and additional metadata.

classes.name: UploadFile
classes.description: A class representing an uploaded file with attributes such as filename, content_type, and file (file-like object). It provides asynchronous methods to read, write, seek, and close the file.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Asynchronously writes data (`str` or `bytes`) to the file.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Asynchronously reads a specified number of bytes (`size`) from the file.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Asynchronously moves the file pointer to a specified offset.
